from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A financial report from a single company containing the specific cash metric."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the financial data")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value for Cash and Cash Equivalents at End of Period")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial period ended")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the cash amount and period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
